instruction: Play the Interstellar trailer video using VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to play the Interstellar video in VLC. After initial setup opens VLC paused, user must click play. The evaluator checks VLC status via HTTP interface to verify the correct file is playing. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric and get_vlc_playing_info getter - no custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Uses existing VLC getter (get_vlc_playing_info) and metric (is_vlc_playing) to check if the correct video file is playing. Simpler than wallpaper task, maintains similar VLC interaction pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both that VLC is playing and that the correct file is loaded
Correct getter logic: get_vlc_playing_info queries VLC HTTP interface and saves status XML for parsing
Correct metric logic: is_vlc_playing parses XML, checks state='playing', and verifies filename using multiple matching strategies (basename, endswith, path contains)
Correct parameter handling: Metric correctly uses 'rule' parameter name and directly accesses rule['type'] and rule['file_name'], following the correct pattern for expected.type='rule'
Correct expected value: File name 'Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer.mp4' matches the downloaded file in config
No state timing issues: VLC HTTP interface is accessible at any time, no postconfig needed
Robust edge case handling: Metric gracefully handles missing file info and searches multiple XML paths for filename
